businesses.business: commercial mechanical, electrical and plumbing contracting

offering_description.value: Designs, installs, maintains and repairs HVAC, plumbing, electrical and related mechanical systems for commercial, industrial and institutional buildings. Also fabricates piping, sheet metal and modular building components. Serves building owners and general contractors through a network of local operating companies.

primary_products.value: prefabricated piping; sheet metal ductwork; modular building assemblies; electrical switchgear and assemblies

primary_services.value: mechanical contracting (HVAC, plumbing, piping); electrical contracting; HVAC maintenance and repair; building automation and controls; energy and facility services

customer_segment.value: B2B: building owners, general contractors, developers, data center and manufacturing operators, hospitals, universities; B2G: government and public institutional facilities, schools

end_markets.value: data centers; manufacturing and industrial; healthcare; education; commercial offices; institutional buildings

revenue_model.value: project or contract: construction installation of mechanical and electrical systems in new and renovated buildings; service fees: maintenance, repair, retrofit and monitoring of building systems

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys equipment and materials, installs and services building systems for owners and general contractors; OEM / manufacturer: fabricates piping, ductwork and modular components used in its own projects

geography_served.value: US national: Operating companies in many US states across major metropolitan markets

specialization.value: related lines: mechanical, electrical and plumbing installation, plus maintenance services and prefabrication

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: local operating companies bidding and selling directly to owners and general contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: contractor licensing, building and electrical codes, safety rules (OSHA), refrigerant environmental rules (EPA)
